seed_protocol.seed: Strict UTF-8 text1-256 bytes,no Unicode/case/whitespace normalization
seed_protocol.framing: FutureCards NUL v1 NUL domain NUL uint32be(seed length) seed uint64be(counter starting0)
seed_protocol.stream: SHA256 blocks consumed as eight uint32be words;separate deck/orientation domains
seed_protocol.sampling: Reject words>=2^32-(2^32 mod n),then modulo n;descending Fisher-Yates without replacement
seed_protocol.celtic: Remove significator,three shuffle/nonempty-cut rounds;one/three layouts use one shuffle without cut
seed_protocol.orientations: Independent randbelow(2):0 upright,1 reversed;upright_only does not change shuffled cards
seed_protocol.replay: Complete validated request,seed/profile/protocol,canonical order/hash,available order,shuffled pack,cuts,draw and orientations
seed_protocol.assurance: Reproducibility and unbiased integer-selection mechanism,not cryptographic security or predictive validity
